policy: Obligations and source/test mapping only. Execution, inherited failures and platform limits are reported independently; mapping a group does not cover every public entry. Specific maintained scripts are outside this PR scope per maintainer direction; they are tested in ea-scripts.

features.name: Packaging and lifecycle

cases: node:scripts/testing/package.source.test.mjs::one private runtime serves main and two popout leases; only final release removes the alias
node:scripts/testing/package.source.test.mjs::destroy clears owned aliases and registrations without clobbering a replacement alias
node:scripts/testing/bundle.test.mjs::production bootstrap supplies matching private React and JSX runtimes
node:scripts/testing/bundle.test.mjs::compressed Excalidraw retains every published offline font asset

features.success: Exact private runtime and protocol load; runtime identity and commands are ready
features.failure: Reject absent/incompatible adapters; roll back partial registration
features.cleanup: Dispose owned adapters, aliases and leases
remaining: Isolated native cold restart and restored-popout session require a prepared isolated application

features.name: Drawing durability

cases: node:scripts/testing/persistence.source.test.mjs::same-path snapshots remain ordered and uncoalesced while another drawing proceeds independently
node:scripts/testing/persistence.source.test.mjs::failed writes preserve the failure receipt, never schedule a backup and release the path for retry
node:scripts/testing/saveCoordinator.source.test.mjs::failed saves keep dirty state and successful retry acknowledges only captured bytes
node:scripts/testing/saveCoordinator.source.test.mjs::an edit during a save queues its own later snapshot instead of clearing the newer dirty revision

features.success: Save/reopen preserves prose, scene metadata and physical receipts
features.failure: Failed writes retain dirty edits; stale API and own-write echoes cannot overwrite
features.cleanup: Close owned views and delete exact owned files and backup keys

features.name: Multiwindow and async work

cases: node:scripts/testing/sceneFiles.source.test.mjs::late file callbacks reject replacement API for the same path and release PDF resources
node:scripts/testing/sceneFiles.source.test.mjs::late file callbacks reject another file and release PDF resources

features.success: Dirty migrations persist through replacement views; survivor remains usable
features.failure: Refuse stale loaders and cancellation completion; unmount before async persistence
features.cleanup: Await actual owned popout closure and settle all test tasks
remaining: Current Electron 43.3.0 emits illegal-access teardown exceptions; confirm on a fixed Electron host without filtering

features.name: Text, links and history
features.success: Parsed/raw and keyboard/button variants retain edit/history behavior
features.failure: Unchanged edit preserves redo; stale targets and rejected edits do not mutate
features.cleanup: Close owned editors and restore focus
remaining: Trusted OS clipboard/paste formats and navigation need independent native coverage

features.name: Images and embedded content
features.success: Decoded output, crop geometry, shared files and embed recovery are correct
features.failure: Stale/cancelled loaders cannot publish into a replacement context
features.cleanup: Dispose image/PDF resources and remove exact owned assets
remaining: PDF import and URL-image network failure require additional portable native cases

features.name: Settings and recovery

cases: node:scripts/testing/settings/settings.source.test.mjs::missing first-install settings are distinct from corruption and synchronized records
node:scripts/testing/settings/settings.source.test.mjs::settings queue coalesces writes, waits for in-flight revisions and applies actions after success
node:scripts/testing/settings/settingsWriter.test.mjs::key order does not change canonical serialization
node:scripts/testing/settings/settingsWriter.test.mjs::array order is semantically significant and preserved

features.success: Defaults, unknown keys and serialized revisions remain intact
features.failure: Missing first install differs from corruption; queue failure remains recoverable
features.cleanup: Restore changed preferences and await writes
remaining: Native corrupt-settings recovery and legacy/new settings UI require an isolated owned session

features.name: Authoring and interaction
features.success: Frames, bindings, groups and authoring survive disk/export round trips
features.failure: Invalid relationships and stale revisions cannot partially mutate
features.cleanup: Restore focus and retire all owned editor roots
remaining: Layer ordering and drag selection have native cases pending; physical pressure/stylus is a separate device gate

features.name: Layouts, navigation and devices
features.success: Measured layout, reachable controls, trusted input and fullscreen restoration
features.failure: Cancel pickers without creating files; fail clipped or missing controls
features.cleanup: Restore theme, mobile mode, preferences, geometry and workspace
remaining: Physical keyboard/stylus/safe-area behavior remains a physical-device release gate

features.name: Import, export and libraries

cases: node:scripts/testing/svg.source.test.mjs::whole-module SVG conversion preserves opacity, transforms and open strokes
node:scripts/testing/svg.source.test.mjs::whole-module SVG fixture imports without mutating source bytes

features.success: Layer/opacity conversion, editable diagrams and actual decoded export output
features.failure: Invalid assets and unavailable services fail without hidden fallback
features.cleanup: Remove temporary render DOM, print listeners and owned output
remaining: Portable native SVG drop/library import and OS clipboard import need additional cases; public EA SVG import is exercised

features.name: ExcalidrawAutomate, CLI and core scripting boundary

cases: node:scripts/testing/cli.test.mjs::registration validates minimum API, optional method and desktop without bumping the baseline
node:scripts/testing/cli.test.mjs::icon discovery is read-only, bounded and snapshot-paginated

features.success: Direct EA authoring, grouping, binding, image and export APIs; idempotent CLI and typed discovery work
features.failure: Interaction refusal, invalid relationships, BUSY and stale revisions retain scene
features.cleanup: Destroy the owned EA instance and settle its resources before deleting the owned scene

features.name: Offline and failure boundaries

cases: node:scripts/testing/bundle.test.mjs::production bootstrap supplies matching private React and JSX runtimes
node:scripts/testing/bundle.test.mjs::compressed Excalidraw retains every published offline font asset
node:scripts/testing/package.source.test.mjs::one private runtime serves main and two popout leases; only final release removes the alias
node:scripts/testing/package.source.test.mjs::destroy clears owned aliases and registrations without clobbering a replacement alias

features.success: Required payload/font bytes are embedded and services resolve through the gateway
features.failure: Invalid protocol, failed activation and malformed input fail closed
features.cleanup: Own and remove debugger/listeners; unrelated errors always fail
remaining: Native real unhandled-error negative control is separate from ordinary clean-error acceptance

features.name: Long-lived stability
features.success: Bounded 1000-element save/reopen and decoded export; roots/APIs retire each cycle
features.failure: Timeout or failed save fails the run without deleting unsettled resources
features.cleanup: Return root count to baseline; delete exact owned scene
remaining: 25-cycle soak and repeated reload need the final profile run; forced-GC heap and physical-device performance are not inferred
